independent_frontend_policy: Pending submissions and actions carry host/thread, UI session, intent ID and revision.
Cancellation and mode changes invalidate earlier steering acknowledgements.
Completed synthetic turns drain queued items in FIFO order. Failure and cancellation retain queued text for explicit start or cancel.
Steering acknowledgements require their original turn to remain active. An unacknowledged steer can return to the queue after that turn terminates.
Acknowledged steering text remains visible. Cancelled items retain identity tombstones to reject duplicate intents.
